chapter: Family and childhood in Baton Rouge
title: Father the shoemaker in small-town Baton Rouge
summary: His father was the most prominent shoe repairer in a town of about 20,000 and wanted his sons to follow the trade.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Your Daddy fixed shoes for the neighborhood people?
Oh yes. My Dad... Baton Rouge was a small town at that time.
Always the capital. But it was a town with I imagine maybe 20,000 people. And my Dad was the most prominent shoe repairer in Baton Rouge at that time.
Did he want you to continue in that business?
